verdict.rationale: GitLab clearly has a native issue tracker. A hands-on user calls its issue tracking 'truly great and well thought of', and its GitHub importer brings over issues, labels and milestones, implying native label support. First-party material also references planning and issues as objects that Chat and agents can act on. However, no first-party doc in the pack describes creating and organizing issues with labels and assignees. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of issue creation and labeling, any evidence of assignees, and evidence of distinguishing bugs, features and requirements (e.g., issue types or requirements management).
